item.title: Inside Mamdani’s $21B housing pitch to Trump at Sunnyside Yard
item.description: The complex would be built on top of the Sunnyside train yard in Queens. The mayor hopes to secure a $21 billion federal grant to build it.

item.title: Retired NYPD detective weighs in on cars seen near Guthrie home
item.description: Retired NYPD Detective David Sarni said the newly obtained video footage showing 12 vehicles near the home could be the most significant lead so far.

item.title: Suspect in Austin mass shooting had Bronx ties and prior arrest in NYC, officials say

item.title: NYC's 'serial puncher' Skiboky Stora convicted in hate crime trial

item.title: NYPD sergeant charged with manslaughter over alleged drunk driving crash

item.title: Plane makes emergency landing in Hudson River; all rescued, no deaths
item.description: Both occupants of a small aircraft that made an emergency landing in the Hudson River Monday evening have been rescued and are expected to recover, according to Orange County Executive Steve Neuhaus.
